ACT IV OF 1995
SINDH PURE FOOD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sind Pure
Food Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th September, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-8/95, dated
27-9-1995.---The Sindh Pure Food (Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 12th June, 1995 and assented to by the
Government of Sindh on 7th August, 1995 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Pure Food (Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force on
such date as Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify.

Amendment of section 2 of W.P. Ordinance No.VII of 1960

ACT IV OF 1995
ACT IV OF 1995
SINDH PURE FOOD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sind Pure
Food Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th September, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-8/95, dated
27-9-1995.---The Sindh Pure Food (Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 12th June, 1995 and assented to by the
Government of Sindh on 7th August, 1995 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 2 of W.P. Ordinance No.VII of 1960.---In
the Sindh Pure Food Ordinance, 1960, hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, in section 2--
(i) in clause (9), the existing
Explanation shall be numbered as "Explanation I" and thereafter the
following new Explanation shall be added:--
"Explanation
II.--- 'Iodized salt' shall for the purpose of this Act be considered as
food either consumed alone or as an ingredient in other foods";
(ii) after
clause (14), the following new clause shall be added:--
(14-A).
---'Iodized salt' means edible common salt (namak) to which potassium iodide
has been added, for the purpose of fortifying or enriching it as a means of
preventing lodging deficiency and disorder, in the manner and quantity as may
be prescribed. "

Amendment of section 37 of W.P. Ordinance No.VII of 1960

Legislature of Sindh.
3. Amendment of section 37 of W.P. Ordinance No.VII of 1960.---In
the said Ordinance , in section 37--
(a) for clause (e) the following
shall be substituted:
"(e)
prohibiting or regulation the use of any particular matter or ingredient--
(i) in the
manufacture or preparation of any food;
(ii) as a
food".
(b) In clause (f), between the
word "food" and the word "shall" the words "including
iodized salt" shall be inserted.
